reason: The rough edge is the visible source of the injury, so the body needs to encounter it before bleeding can be stopped.
expectation: The body will receive a small cut that breaks the skin and a blood vessel.

effect: The cut has exposed a bleeding vessel, so the next step is to use the clotting components.
reaction: The narrowed vessel is a useful detail, though its role isn't explained yet.
reason: Platelets at the cut are positioned to help limit the bleeding.
expectation: The platelets will gather at the damaged vessel and begin forming a plug.

effect: The platelet plug slows the leak; the remaining clotting components may strengthen it.
reaction: The explanation makes the platelets' role clear.
reason: Activated clotting factors are likely to act on fibrinogen to form the material that reinforces the plug.
expectation: The clotting factors will convert fibrinogen into fibrin.

effect: The clotting factors converted fibrinogen into threads that can reinforce the platelet plug.
reaction: The mesh among platelets makes the connection clear.
reason: The fibrin threads appear suited to strengthening the plug at the damaged vessel.
expectation: The fibrin mesh will reinforce the platelet plug and stop the bleeding.

effect: The fibrin mesh reinforced the platelet plug and stopped the bleeding; the skin remains open.
reaction: The distinction between a sealed vessel and an open skin cut was useful.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding fibrin to the platelet plug was most worthwhile because it showed how the two components work together to stop the leak.

leastWorthwhile.text: Creating fibrin threads felt a little abrupt: the result showed the mesh but did not explain the clotting factors' role in making it.

surprise.text: The vessel was already narrowed immediately after the cut, although that response was not explained.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; each followed from the injury or the clotting components available.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the still-open skin repairs itself after the vessel is sealed.
